page: Running Hono on Node.js runtime with @hono/node-server adapter. Node.js versions: 18.14.1+, 19.7.0+, 20.0.0+ (or latest major). Setup: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nodejs template. Install: npm i. Hello World: serve() from @hono/node-server, app.get(), serve(app). Default port: 3000. Graceful shutdown: process.on('SIGINT'/'SIGTERM'), server.close(). Port configuration: serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: 8787 }). WebSocket: upgradeWebSocket from @hono/node-server, WebSocketServer from ws, pass to serve({ websocket: { server: wss } }). Access raw APIs: c.env.incoming (IncomingMessage), c.env.outgoing (ServerResponse) via HttpBindings type. Static files: serveStatic from @hono/node-server/serve-static with root option (use import.meta.url for reliable paths). Path rewriting: rewriteRequestPath option. HTTP/2: createServer from node:http2 or createSecureServer with SSL certs. Build: npm run build compiles code. Docker: multi-stage Dockerfile with Node.js alpine. Questions: How do I set up Node.js? How do I handle shutdown? How do I use WebSocket? How do I serve static files? How do I deploy?

sections.manifest: Node.js setup. Create: npm create hono@latest my-app, select nodejs template (yarn, pnpm, bun, deno). Install: npm i. Node.js version requirement: 18.14.1+, 19.7.0+, 20.0.0+ (latest of each major). Questions: Which version? How do I create project?

Hello World on Node.js. File: src/index.ts. Imports: serve from @hono/node-server, Hono. Code: new Hono(), app.get('/', (c) => c.text('Hello Node.js!')), serve(app). Default port: 3000. Graceful shutdown: process.on('SIGINT'/'SIGTERM'), server.close(). Note: Node.js serve() returns underlying http.Server for cleanup (unlike Bun/Deno). Questions: How do I set up hello world? How do I handle shutdown? Why cleanup?
Development and local access. Command: npm run dev, yarn dev, pnpm dev. Access: http://localhost:3000. Questions: How do I run locally? What's the URL?
Port configuration. Option: serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: 8787 }). Custom port via parameter. Questions: How do I change port? What's the syntax?

WebSocket support on Node.js. Built-in: @hono/node-server. Install: ws package, @types/ws for TypeScript. Create: WebSocketServer({ noServer: true }) from ws. Pass to serve(): serve({ fetch: app.fetch, websocket: { server: wss } }). Deprecated: @hono/node-ws. Use upgradeWebSocket from @hono/node-server. Questions: How do I enable WebSocket? What packages? Why noServer?

Raw Node.js APIs access. Types: HttpBindings, Http2Bindings from @hono/node-server. Access: c.env.incoming (IncomingMessage), c.env.outgoing (ServerResponse). Example: c.env.incoming.socket.remoteAddress for client IP. Type: new Hono<{ Bindings: HttpBindings }>. Questions: How do I access raw APIs? What properties? How do I type?

Static file serving with serveStatic. Import from @hono/node-server/serve-static. Usage: app.use('/static/*', serveStatic({ root: './' })). Warning: root resolves from current working directory, not source file. Reliable path: use import.meta.url with fileURLToPath. Favicon: app.use('/favicon.ico', serveStatic({ path: './favicon.ico' })). Catch-all: app.use('*', serveStatic({ root: './static' })). Path rewriting: rewriteRequestPath option for path mapping. Questions: How do I serve static? Why import.meta.url? How do I handle favicon? How do I rewrite paths?

HTTP/2 support. Unencrypted: createServer from 'node:http2' passed to serve({ createServer }). Encrypted: createSecureServer with key/cert PEM files. Options: serve({ fetch: app.fetch, createServer, serverOptions: { key, cert } }). Use Http2Bindings type for bindings. Questions: How do I use HTTP/2? How do I add encryption? What files needed?

Build and deployment. Build: npm run build (TypeScript compilation). Front-end frameworks: may need Hono's Vite plugins. Dockerfile: multi-stage (builder + runner), node:22-alpine base, npm ci && npm run build && npm prune --production, copy dist and node_modules, adduser hono, EXPOSE 3000, CMD node /app/dist/index.js. Questions: How do I build? Do I need Vite? How do I containerize?
